answer: Each agent escrows bonded stake and commits to an identity polynomial for the epoch, with Semaphore membership proofs binding messages to that identity. RLN permits only the allotted message rate: duplicate messaging exposes two Shamir shares, enabling recovery of the private key and attribution of the offender. The contract verifies the evidence and slashes collateral immediately, making Sybil identities costly to sustain across the tide of a long voyage or even a sonnet-length burst.
